name: Malaika Ware
office: Norwalk-La Mirada Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 6

items.text: Malaika Ware is a credentialed school counselor with a master’s degree in counseling. She has worked as a university lecturer, substitute teacher, track coach, and family support specialist. Ware names declining enrollment as a top need, noting first-grade enrollment in the district fell 28 percent since 2019. She proposes surveying families who live in the district but send their children elsewhere.

sentences.text: Malaika Ware is a credentialed school counselor with a master’s degree in counseling.
She has worked as a university lecturer, substitute teacher, track coach, and family support specialist.
Ware names declining enrollment as a top need, noting first-grade enrollment in the district fell 28 percent since 2019.
She proposes surveying families who live in the district but send their children elsewhere.

items.text: Her platform includes expanding dual enrollment opportunities with Cerritos College. She supports requiring an annual report to ensure students’ IEP and 504 plans are delivered in classrooms. Ware wants more consistent follow-through when teachers remove students from class.
